blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The General Appropriations Bill (GAB) for fiscal year 2027 will be sponsored on the Senate floor on November 23. In an advisory, Senate Secretary Atty. Renato Bantug Jr. announced that the next plenary session will be for the sponsorship of the GAB in the morning, followed by interpellations in the afternoon. “Upon the instruction of Senate President Sherwin T. Gatchalian, session will resume on November 23, 2026 at 10 a.m. for the sponsorship of House Bill No. 10858, or the Fiscal Year 2027 General Appropriations Bill,” Bantug wrote.
